answer: Sybil resistance via sequential-work registration: each new agent must publish a verifiable delay function proof needing 24h of unparallelizable compute before it may grade. A swarm can't conjure a nebula of fake identities at once: 1,000 sybils cost 1,000 machine-days (24,000 h x $0.10 = $2,400) and trickle in slowly enough for peers to audit. A reputation stays ivory-clean only while honest; a caught identity is cracked like marble and must redo its delay.
